description: This file contains a series of shell script tests designed to verify the behavior of a git repository quarantine and push restrictions. It performs actions such as repository initialization, hooks setup, object creation, rejection handling, and path separator tests to ensure proper enforcement of rules during push operations.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Sets up a test case that expects success for the provided commands.

methods.name: test_hook
methods.description: Configures or runs repository hook setup commands.

methods.name: test_commit
methods.description: Creates a new git commit with specified changes.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Runs commands that are expected to fail, validating failure conditions.

methods.name: test_have_prereq
methods.description: Checks for prerequisites like platform-specific capabilities before executing tests.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of the test script.
